text: Which of the following is one of the four maximally entangled two-qubit Bell states?
choices: |00> + |11> written as a product of two single-qubit superpositions
explanation: |Phi+> = (|00> + |11>)/sqrt(2) is a Bell state: normalized and non-factorable. Choice 2 is a product (separable) state, not entangled; choices 1 and 3 are unnormalized (missing the 1/sqrt(2)), and choice 1 wrongly implies the state factorizes.
